base_colors=[6,2,8,3]
sources=[
 [[8]*6]+[[8,1,1,1,1,8] for _ in range(4)]+[[8]*6],
 [[5]*6,[5,1,1,5,1,5],[5]*6,[5]*6,[5]*6,[5]*6],
 [[9]*6,[9,1,9,1,1,9],[9,1,9,1,1,9],[9]*6,[9,1,9,1,1,9],[9]*6],
 [[4]*6,[4,1,4,1,1,4],[4,1,4,1,1,4],[4]*6,[4,1,1,1,1,4],[4]*6],
]
def composite(base, src):
    tile=[[base]*8 for _ in range(8)]
    for i in range(6):
        for j in range(6):
            if src[i][j] != 1: # pattern cells; background 1 is transparent
                tile[i+1][j+1]=src[i][j]
    return tile
comps=[composite(b,s) for b,s in zip(base_colors,sources)]
out=[comps[0][r]+comps[1][r] for r in range(8)]+[comps[2][r]+comps[3][r] for r in range(8)]
print(len(out), [len(r) for r in out])
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))
